<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Lawbringer Warpriest](/NPCs.aspx?ID=3141)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Mortals whose ancestry has been influenced by [archons](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=365) are called lawbringers. They may have mortal ancestors who fought alongside archons against the forces of evil and entropy, or they may have been born from a union between an archon and a mortal. Many lawbringers seek adventure to bringing order to the world.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 22

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 20

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 17
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 5">[Lawbringer Warpriest](/NPCs.aspx?ID=3141)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Human" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=627" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
<trait label="Nephilim" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=518" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 267

**Perception** +11; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Empyrean](/Languages.aspx?ID=115)

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +11, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +11, [Medicine](/Skills.aspx?ID=9) +10, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +12, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) +7

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +4

**Dex** +1

**Con** +3

**Int** +0

**Wis** +3

**Cha** +2
</row>

**Items**
[Crossbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=67) (10 bolts), [Greatsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=24), [Half Plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=12)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 23 

**Fort** +12 

**Ref** +8 

**Will** +12 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 64

</row>

**Responsive Recovery** <actions string="Reaction" /> **Trigger** One of the lawbringer's allies is reduced to 0 Hit Points; **Requirements** The lawbringer has a [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1554) spell prepared; **Effect** Before the ally falls [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95) or dies, the lawbringer Strides toward them and casts a 2-action _heal_ spell targeting the ally. The ally remains standing.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
greatsword +13 ([versatile P](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 1d12+7 slashing

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
crossbow +11 ([range increment 120 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [reload 1](/Traits.aspx?ID=254)),
**Damage** 1d8+3 piercing

**Divine Prepared Spells** DC 20, attack +12
- **Cantrips (3rd)**
[Daze](/Spells.aspx?ID=61), [Divine Lance](/Spells.aspx?ID=84), [Forbidding Ward](/Spells.aspx?ID=126), [Guidance](/Spells.aspx?ID=142), [Light](/Spells.aspx?ID=171)
- **1st**
[Harm](/Spells.aspx?ID=146), [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), [Sure Strike](/Spells.aspx?ID=1709)
- **2nd**
[Enlarge](/Spells.aspx?ID=102), [Harm](/Spells.aspx?ID=146), [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148)
- **3rd**
[Blindness](/Spells.aspx?ID=26), [Haste](/Spells.aspx?ID=147)

**Domain Spells 1 Focus Point,** DC 20
- **3rd**
[Athletic Rush](/Spells.aspx?ID=402)

**Channel Smite** <actions string="Two Actions" />  **Requirements** The lawbringer has a [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1554) or [_harm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1552) spell prepared; **Effect** The lawbringer makes a melee Strike and expends a _harm_ or _heal_ spell. On a hit, they cast the 1-action version of the spell to damage the target. The target automatically gets a failure on its save (or a critical failure if the lawbringer's Strike was a critical hit). The spell doesn't have the [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645) trait when cast this way.

</column>
